fields.name: userId
fields.description: Recipient (filter target). The userId the row was addressed to — the inbox reads with `filter: { userId: <me> }` so each user only sees their own rows.

fields.name: fromId
fields.description: IAM sub of the sender. Duplicates CreatedBy so the Sent folder can filter explicitly (same precedent as Notification.actorId).

fields.name: fromName
fields.description: Display name of the sender at send time — what the recipient's inbox renders.

fields.name: fromEmail
fields.description: Email of the sender at send time, shown in the reader's meta line when present.

fields.name: toName
fields.description: Denormalized recipient display name — what the sender's Sent folder renders.

fields.name: readAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp stamped by mark-as-read. Empty string while unread; non-empty marks the row read (same convention as Notification.readAt).
